name: Weekly Pipeline Report

parameters.content: This workflow runs every Monday at 8:00 AM ET, retrieves all lead data from the CRM, and emails the owner a Weekly Pipeline Report: new leads, bookings, stale leads, bookings/new ratio, and top lead sources for the trailing 7-day window. Email is sent by default; SMS is built but off by default - both toggled via the CONFIG block at the top of 'Build Weekly Report'.

description: Weekly Monday 8AM ET pipeline report. Emails owner new leads, bookings, stale count, bookings/new ratio, and top sources for the trailing 7-day window. Email default ON, SMS built but OFF - configurable via CONFIG block.
